intro: The Montreal East Refinery (Gulf Canada) is a small petrochemical refinery located inside the city of Montréal-Est and inside the Coastal Petrochemical fields.  The operator of the refining unit is Coastal Petrochemical (Petrochimie Coastal du Canada).
